title: README spec index should include a Signal ID column for signal-to-spec traceability
description:
The spec frontmatter stores signal_id when a spec was authored in response to a signal (moeb.start-spec-from-signal.md). The README.md specification index table has no corresponding column, so tracing which signal triggered a given spec requires parsing each spec file's frontmatter individually.

Adding a nullable Signal ID column to the index table would allow tooling (and the fix_signal skill) to resolve the implementing spec for a given signal directly from the index, without scanning spec files. This is complementary to signal a1000083 which proposes auto-resolution in start_run.
proposed_resolution: Add a Signal ID column (nullable, value or dash) to the README spec index table. Update spec.skill.md Phase 5 (Link README) to populate this column with the frontmatter signal_id value when present, and a dash when absent. Update the spec index row format documentation in spec.skill.md to include the new column. Backfill existing spec rows with signal_id values where the frontmatter field is set.
